name: Afrobeat horn-section riff
desc: Punchy Fela-style horn-section stabs — short-short-long call figures following a I-vi-IV-V (E C#m A B) vamp, thickened by an off(1/8) harmony voice (default an octave down for a fat two-horn section) with a slow filter sweep and a 4-bar shout fill at peak.

harm.doc: section harmony interval in semitones (-12 octave, 7 fifth, 12 up)

code.sparse: note('<[~ ~ ~ e5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ g#5 ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ c#5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ e5 ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ a5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ c#6 ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ b5 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ d#6 ~ ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('sawtooth').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}).slow(20)).lpq(2).attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.2).release(.12).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(.2).orbit(5).play()
code.full: note('<[e5 b4 b4 e5 ~ ~ ~ g#5 g#5 e5 ~ ~] [c#5 g#4 g#4 c#5 ~ ~ ~ e5 e5 c#5 ~ ~] [a5 e5 e5 a5 ~ ~ ~ c#6 c#6 a5 ~ ~] [b5 f#5 f#5 b5 ~ ~ ~ d#6 d#6 b5 ~ ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('sawtooth').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.14).sustain(.3).release(.08).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(.2).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(${harm})).gain(${gain}*.7)).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note('<[b4 ~ b4 e5 e5 ~ g#5 ~ g#5 e5 b5 ~] [g#4 ~ g#4 c#5 c#5 ~ e5 ~ e5 c#5 g#5 ~] [e5 ~ e5 a5 a5 ~ c#6 ~ c#6 a5 e6 ~] [f#5 ~ f#5 b5 b5 ~ d#6 ~ d#6 b5 f#6 ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('sawtooth').lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.5).slow(12)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.12).sustain(.3).release(.07).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(.2).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(${harm})).gain(${gain}*.7)).every(4, x=>x.lastOf(2, y=>y.fast(2))).orbit(5).play()
